title: Among all cards that are legal in the Legacy format and have unknown power
question: Among all cards that are legal in the Legacy format and have unknown power (either NULL or '*'), find those illustrated by artists who have also created cards in sets with Japanese translations. Return the card names and their converted mana costs, ordered by mana cost descending, limited to the top 5.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049, c.XCL_011
FROM cards c
WHERE (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'legacy'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  )
  AND c.XCL_002 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_002
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN set_translations st2 ON c2.XCL_063 = st2.XCL_093
    WHERE st2.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 5

FROM cards c
WHERE (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*')

    WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'legacy'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  )
  AND c.XCL_002 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_002
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN set_translations st2 ON c2.XCL_063 = st2.XCL_093
    WHERE st2.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 5

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049, c.XCL_011
FROM cards c
WHERE (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072
      AND l.XCL_084 = 'legacy'
      AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  )
  AND c.XCL_002 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_002
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN set_translations st2 ON c2.XCL_063 = st2.XCL_093
    WHERE st2.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 5

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049, c.XCL_011
FROM cards c
WHERE c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*'
  AND c.XCL_002 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_002
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN set_translations st2 ON c2.XCL_063 = st2.XCL_093
    WHERE st2.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072 AND l.XCL_084 = 'legacy'
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 5

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    c.XCL_002 AS card_name,
    c.XCL_011 AS converted_mana_cost
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
JOIN 
    sets s ON c.XCL_012 = s.XCL_099
JOIN 
    set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
WHERE 
    l.XCL_085 = 'Legacy'
    AND (c.XCL_006 IS NULL OR c.XCL_006 = '*')
    AND st.XCL_094 = 'Japanese'
ORDER BY 
    c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 5
